title: AI Tested — Model Context Protocol (MCP) — connecting AI assistants to your data

layers.text: Connecting AI to your data — one open standard instead of a custom connector per source.
An MCP server exposes your data; an MCP client like Claude connects to it.

GOOGLE DRIVE  ·  SLACK  ·  GITHUB
POSTGRES  ·  PUPPETEER

captions.text: AI assistants are trapped behind information silos.
Anthropic's Model Context Protocol is one open standard connecting AI to your data.
An MCP server exposes your data; an MCP client like Claude connects to it.
Pre-built MCP servers exist for Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Postgres and Puppeteer.
